sloka: तस्मिन् दग्धे तदा कुक्षौ समुद्रः सरिताम् पतिः ।राघवम् सर्वशास्त्रज्ञमिदम् वचनम्ब्रवीत् ॥६-२२-४३॥।।
transliteration: tasmin dagdhe tadā kukṣau samudraḥ saritām patiḥ ।rāghavam sarvaśāstrajñamidam vacanambravīt ॥6-22-43॥।।

translations.english: Thereafter when that land of Drumakulyam was burnt (by Rama's arrow) the Lord of rivers looked at Rama who was learned in all sastras spoke these words.
